verdict.rationale: Supermemory builds its knowledge graph automatically. Its documented customization levers are indirect: ingestion guidance that tells it what content matters (supermemory-docs-45), custom topical 'buckets' for profile facts (supermemory-docs-49, supermemory-docs-59), and custom metadata properties for filtering (supermemory-docs-39). Nothing shows the graph's entity types, edge types or ontology being defined. Missing for 10: user-defined entity types, custom edge/relationship types, ontology or schema definition for the graph, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
